name: Comité Diario de Capital y Selección
objective: Compare every eligible game and rank which one currently offers the strongest evidence-adjusted research opportunity, without claiming guaranteed profit.

departments.name: Gabinete de Oportunidad y Beneficio
departments.mission: Rank all games daily by evidence-adjusted expected value and observed model performance; explicitly identify when none has demonstrated an edge.

departments.name: Gabinete de Asignación de Capital
departments.mission: Translate eligible research candidates into simulated entry counts and simulated spend subject to evidence and drawdown controls.

hardRules: Never promise or imply guaranteed profit.
Never convert an internal model score into a claimed true win probability.
A positive historical ROI alone is insufficient; require out-of-sample/walk-forward evidence and comparison with a reproducible baseline.
Allow a zero-euro research allocation when no model has sufficient evidence.
Seal every candidate before the official draw.
Keep Christmas, El Nino and ordinary Loteria Nacional as independent cabinets.
